story.title: Fake Allu Arjun AI Chatbots Remain Live Despite Delhi High Court Personality Rights Order
story.summary: AI platform CelebsGPT continues to host unauthorised chatbots mimicking actor Allu Arjun's persona on its platform and via Instagram, despite the Delhi High Court having granted him personality rights protection in an ongoing case. The persistence of these fake AI avatars after a court order highlights a growing enforcement gap in India's nascent AI personality rights framework. Legal experts say the case tests whether Indian courts can compel AI platforms — many of which are foreign-operated — to comply with domestic personality rights rulings.
